title.english: The Work Order in the Envelope

pairs.target: yú shīfu zài lái , shì liǎngtiān hòu de xiàkè shífēn .
pairs.english: Master Yu came again at the end of class two days later.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅再来，是两天后的下课时分。

pairs.target: zhècì tā méiyǒu bèi mùxiá , shǒulǐ zhǐyǒu yìzhī zhǎi xìnfēng , jìnmén xiān bǎ jiǎn lǎoshī de shū fàngzài ménfáng zhuōshàng , xiàng pà shuí gǎn zài qiántou tíxǐng .
pairs.english: This time she carried no wooden case, only a narrow envelope in her hand; entering, she first put Instructor Jian's book on the gatehouse table as though afraid someone might remind her before she could.
pairs.hanzi: 这次她没有背木匣，手里只有一只窄信封，进门先把简老师的书放在门房桌上，像怕谁赶在前头提醒。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng lóutī xiàlái , kànjiàn tā biàn wèn qúkǒu zěnmeyàng le .
pairs.english: Tavi came down the stairs, saw her and asked how things were at the inlet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从楼梯下来，看见她便问渠口怎么样了。

pairs.target: tā shuō xīn bǎn hái zài , jiù bǎn yě hái zài , tiějiā zànshí méi qǔ , lǎorén yǐjīng ná bù gěi tā gài shàng le .
pairs.english: She said the new board was still there, the old board too; she hadn't collected the clamp yet, and the old man had already covered it with cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 她说新板还在，旧板也还在，铁夹暂时没取，老人已经拿布给它盖上了。

pairs.target: " nà liǎngtiáo hóngxiàn ne ? "
pairs.english: “And those two red lines?”
pairs.hanzi: “那两条红线呢？”

pairs.target: " yě méi zìjǐ zǒu . "
pairs.english: “They haven't walked away by themselves either.”
pairs.hanzi: “也没自己走。”

pairs.target: tā ràng tā zài ménfáng zuòxià , bǎ xìnfēng lǐ de zhǐ chōuchūlái , shì tā nà liǎngzhāng jìlù de chāojiàn , xiàmiàn duō le yìháng shōujiàn rìqī .
pairs.english: She had him sit in the gatehouse and pulled the papers from the envelope; they were copies of his two records, with a receipt date added below.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他在门房坐下，把信封里的纸抽出来，是他那两张记录的抄件，下面多了一行收件日期。

pairs.target: qú wù suǒ zhǎodào le dāngchū tiān qī de dēngjì , xiě de shì kūshuǐ shí zànyòng , qīxiàn nà yìlán què zhǐ xiě lìngxíngtōngzhī .
pairs.english: The Canal Office had found the entry for the added paint: it stated temporary use in low water, but the duration field said only “until further notice.”
pairs.hanzi: 渠务所找到了当初添漆的登记，写的是枯水时暂用，期限那一栏却只写另行通知。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn zhè suànbusuàn hái zài yòng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether that counted as still in use.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问这算不算还在用。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō , shàngtóu zhòngcài de rén juéde suàn , xiàmiàn děng chuán de rén juéde jìrán jiào zànyòng , zǒng bùnéng yìzhí yòngdào tāmen búyòng chēngchuán wéizhǐ .
pairs.english: Master Yu said the people growing vegetables above thought it counted; the people waiting for boats below thought that since it was temporary, it couldn't keep being used until they no longer had to pole boats.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说，上头种菜的人觉得算，下面等船的人觉得既然叫暂用，总不能一直用到他们不用撑船为止。

pairs.target: tā shuō de hěn píng , tǎ wéi què xiǎngqǐ liǎnggè rén zài píngtái biān yuè shuō yuè kuài de yàngzi .
pairs.english: She spoke evenly, but Tavi remembered the sight of the two people speaking faster and faster beside the platform.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平，塔维却想起两个人在平台边越说越快的样子。

pairs.target: " tāmen wèn nǐ zěnme gǎi ? "
pairs.english: “Did they ask you how to change it?”
pairs.hanzi: “他们问你怎么改？”

pairs.target: " wèn le . "
pairs.english: “They did.”
pairs.hanzi: “问了。”

pairs.target: " nǐ zěnme shuō ? "
pairs.english: “What did you say?”
pairs.hanzi: “你怎么说？”

pairs.target: " huànbǎn de gōngqián , bù bāo tì tāmen fēnshuǐ . "
pairs.english: “The pay for replacing the board doesn't cover dividing water for them.”
pairs.hanzi: “换板的工钱，不包替他们分水。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , tā què méi xiào , shuō tā dāying bǎ jiù biāojì liúzhù , bù děngyú tā búzàihu hòutou zěnmebàn .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed once, but she didn't; she said agreeing to preserve the old marks didn't mean she was indifferent to what happened next.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，她却没笑，说她答应把旧标记留住，不等于她不在乎后头怎么办。

pairs.target: xiàcì qù , huìtóng liǎngbiān gè zhǎo yígè cháng zài de rén , bǎ shíjì děng shuǐ , hòuchuán de shíchén wèn qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Next visit she would find a regular person from each side and establish the actual times of waiting for water and waiting for boats.
pairs.hanzi: 下次去，会同两边各找一个常在的人，把实际等水、候船的时辰问清楚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nàxiē rén wèibì jìde zhǔn , tā biàn diǎntóu , shuō suǒyǐ yě bùnéng zhǐ wèn yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi said those people might not recall accurately; she nodded and said that was why she could not ask just once.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那些人未必记得准，她便点头，说所以也不能只问一次。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn chāojiàn , fāxiànzìjǐ nà dào cán zì de wān hái zài , pángbiān de bā méiyǒu nuó guòlái gàizhù tā .
pairs.english: He looked down at the copies and found that curve of his, the surviving half-character, still there; the eight beside it had not been moved over to cover it.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看抄件，发现自己那道残字的弯还在，旁边的八没有挪过来盖住它。

pairs.target: zhè ràng tā xīnlǐ sōngkuài le yìdiǎn , què yòu juéde zìjǐ de huó xiǎo de chūqí .
pairs.english: This made him a little easier at heart, yet he felt his own work was astonishingly small.
pairs.hanzi: 这让他心里松快了一点，却又觉得自己的活小得出奇。

pairs.target: yú shīfu cóng xìnfēng lǐ lìng ná yìzhāng gōng dān , gěi tā kàn míngzì .
pairs.english: Master Yu took a further work order from the envelope, letting him look at the name.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅从信封里另拿一张工单，给他看名字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de wéi bèi xiě de tài kuān , jīhū pèngshàng pángbiān de gé xiàn , dàn méiyǒu xiěcuò .
pairs.english: The second character in Tavi's name was written too wide, almost touching the next grid line, but it was correct.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的维被写得太宽，几乎碰上旁边的格线，但没有写错。

pairs.target: tā shuō bànrì jìlù yǐjīng àn shí bàoshàng xuégōng , búshì suànzuò tā duō dài le yígè bānggōng .
pairs.english: She said the half-day recording had already been accurately reported to the academy, not counted as her bringing an extra helper.
pairs.hanzi: 她说半日记录已经按实报上学宫，不是算作她多带了一个帮工。

pairs.target: tā wèn zìjǐ shìbushì hái gāi xiě xiē shénme .
pairs.english: He asked whether he should still write anything.
pairs.hanzi: 他问自己是不是还该写些什么。

pairs.target: " búyòng tì wǒ bǔ hǎohuà . "
pairs.english: “No need to add nice words for me.”
pairs.hanzi: “不用替我补好话。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe nà liǎngzhāng chāojiàn , shuō yǒu kànlòu de cái bǔ , bié yīnwèi shōu le gōngqián , jiù bǎ nàtiān méi fāshēng de yě xiějìnqù .
pairs.english: She pointed to the two copies and said to add only anything missed, not also write the things that hadn't happened that day just because he'd been paid.
pairs.hanzi: 她指着那两张抄件，说有看漏的才补，别因为收了工钱，就把那天没发生的也写进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méishōu dào , tā zhèhuí zhōngyú xiào le , shuō zhàng shàng jì le , qián hái méi dàoshǒu , dào jìde hěn qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi said he hadn't received it; this time she finally laughed and said the account was entered, the cash not yet in his hands, and he'd remembered that very clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没收到，她这回终于笑了，说账上记了，钱还没到手，倒记得很清楚。

pairs.target: tā qǐshēn yào zǒu , yòu huítóu wèn nài lěi yǒuméiyǒu gēn tā shuō guò , xià yìchéng zhǔnbèi qù nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: She rose to leave, then turned back to ask whether Nerai had told him where she planned to go next.
pairs.hanzi: 她起身要走，又回头问奈蕾有没有跟他说过，下一程准备去哪里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yáotóu , shǒulǐ de gōng dān hūrán bèi tā niē chū yìtiáo zhéhén .
pairs.english: Tavi shook his head, suddenly squeezing a crease into the work order in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摇头，手里的工单忽然被他捏出一条折痕。

pairs.target: yú shīfu kànjiàn le , jiào tā bié huāng , tā búshì jīnrì chū chéng , zhǐshì zài wèn yántú dài xìn de rén .
pairs.english: Master Yu noticed and told him not to worry: she wasn't leaving town today, only asking about people who could carry letters along the route.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅看见了，叫他别慌，她不是今日出城，只是在问沿途带信的人。

pairs.target: " yào zǒu duōjiǔ ? "
pairs.english: “How long will she be away?”
pairs.hanzi: “要走多久？”

pairs.target: " zhè děi wèn tā , wǒ bú tì tā dá . "
pairs.english: “You must ask her that; I won't answer for her.”
pairs.hanzi: “这得问她，我不替她答。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ gōng dān fàng píng , xiǎng wèn tā shìbushì yòu qù chì píng , zuìzhōng méiyǒu bǎ zhège míngzì shuō chūkǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi flattened the work order, wanting to ask whether she was going to Red Flats again, but in the end did not speak the name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把工单放平，想问她是不是又去赤坪，最终没有把这个名字说出口。

pairs.target: yú shīfu tuīkāi mén shí , yìzhī shǒu yòu shēnhuílái , bǎ zhuōshàng de shū cháo mén fánglǐ tuī yuǎn yìdiǎn , miǎnde bèi rén shùnshǒu názǒu .
pairs.english: As Master Yu opened the door, one hand reached back again and pushed the book on the table farther inside the gatehouse, lest someone take it in passing.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅推开门时，一只手又伸回来，把桌上的书朝门房里推远一点，免得被人顺手拿走。

pairs.target: " jìde gàosù jiǎn lǎoshī , shū huílái le . "
pairs.english: “Remember to tell Instructor Jian the book is back.”
pairs.hanzi: “记得告诉简老师，书回来了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying , bǎ zhè jù jìde bǐ shōujiàn rìqī hái láo .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed, remembering that line even more firmly than the receipt date.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应，把这句记得比收件日期还牢。
